changes.reason: Keep the original usage record in the Redis processing receipt before writing usage. A replacement writer recovers the original timestamp after a write and reads the usage storage receipt to distinguish completed writes from quota rejections.

kubernetes.reason: Native Redis replay was exercised locally. Node Host execution on Kubernetes is unverified.
constraints: The application owns Redis connectivity and the processing lease. Coordinate metering writer versions when sharing a Redis keyspace.

aws-lambda.reason: The existing metering provider and claim transitions apply without a Lambda-specific adapter. Lambda execution is unverified.
constraints: Await metering before invocation exit. A replacement invocation needs the same Redis keyspace and an available lease to resume the write.

cloudflare.reason: This change does not establish Cloudflare Workers or Node Container metering support.
constraints: A Cloudflare host would require a compatible Redis client and a Redis service that supports the existing multi-key Lua operations.
